name: The Sewers
desc:
Underneath an enormous city, the relatively comfortable sewers are the only place for you to go. Watch your back, however, people down on their luck aren't the only things that have made the sewers their home.

- 🔨 Build a shelter to keep strangers out and survive.
- ♻️ Build bottle collectors to make money.
- ❤️ Try not to die.

📷 max graphics are recommended!
🛠️ builds save in private servers. You can access the private server host panel in the top left corner

Please leave a like on the game to show your support! 👍
